title: Cellectis’ Annual Shareholders General Meeting to be Held on June 25, 2026
summary: New York, NY – May 20, 2026 – Cellectis (the “Company”) (Euronext Growth: ALCLS- NASDAQ: CLLS), a clinical-stage biotechnology company...
body_markdown:
**New York, NY – May 20, 2026 -** Cellectis (the “Company”) (Euronext Growth: ALCLS- NASDAQ: CLLS), a clinical-stage biotechnology company using its pioneering gene-editing platform to develop life-saving cell and gene therapies, announced today that it will hold its annual general meeting on June 25, 2026 at 2:30 p.m. CET at the Biopark auditorium, 11 rue Watt, 4th floor, 75013 Paris, France.


The notice of meeting is available on the Cellectis website:[https://www.cellectis.com/en/investors/general-meetings/](https://www.cellectis.com/en/investors/general-meetings/)
